$comment: United States - Wave 4. The one market where we already hold lab-confirmed
training data: NHANES 2017-2018 is downloaded, with HbA1c (6,401) and
fasting glucose (3,036) as objective labels rather than self-report.
So the US is the natural FIRST market to reach validation_status
'provisional' - ahead of Bangladesh, whose DiaBD set is still pending.

prevalence_prior.source: IDF Diabetes Atlas; cross-check against NHANES-derived prevalence

risk_model.$note: All of Us is deliberately diverse and is the fairness/bias testing set for every market, not just this one.

food.composition_source: USDA FoodData Central (free API, US public domain)
food.$note: The only market whose composition source is already licence-clear.

features.$note: Clinician mode here makes us a HIPAA Business Associate the moment a clinic pays us - BAA, audit logs, HIPAA-grade infra. Not a flag flip.

regulatory.regime: FDA General Wellness / CDS guidance (revised Jan 2026, deregulatory direction)
regulatory.gatekeeper: FDA intended-purpose boundary + FTC Health Breach Notification Rule
regulatory.notes: Favourable but conditional: must avoid disease/diagnostic/clinical-management claims. For clinician-facing CDS the FDA expects clear documentation of how the software works - the 'How our AI works' page is a REGULATORY ARTEFACT here, not marketing. State laws stack: California CMIA/CPRA, Washington My Health My Data.
